svg.text: Only for the motor option. Base plate 130 x 117 x 6 on top of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back lower rail, two M8 bolts through the rail.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two dropouts 60 wide, 6 thick, 110 tall, welded upright on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: base, 76 apart inside: they take the hub motor's axle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Axle slots 12 mm wide, centre 96 above the base, open upward

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so the motor drops in; torque washers stop it turning.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chain guard: sheet cover outside the motor chain on two spacers

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the outer dropout, with a rim round the jackshaft sprocket.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: hub motor 10 mm clear of the base and 17 clear of the frame;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its sprocket in line with the jackshaft sprocket (straight edge).
